data.name: Subhajit
data.gender_notes: Subhajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Subhajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'subha' meaning good and 'jit' meaning victorious. It signifies a good and auspicious victory. In Bengali, it means good and prosperous. The name Subhajit carries the meaning “Good, auspicious, propitious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subhajit usually hope their child will grow to embody good, auspicious, propitious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhajit is a divine name that signifies good fortune, prosperity, and success in spiritual pursuits.
data.etymology: Subhajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, auspicious, propitious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhajit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
